name: Gustav III
contribution: King of Sweden from 1771 until his assassination in 1792.
legacy: Seizing power from the government in a coup d'état, called the Swedish Revolution, in 1772 that ended the Age of Liberty, he initiated a campaign to restore a measure of royal autocracy
image_credit: Workshop of Alexander Roslin · Public domain

checks.lead: Gustav III (24 January [O.S. 13 January] 1746 – 29 March 1792), also called Gustavus III, was King of Sweden from 1771 until his assassination in 1792. He was the eldest son of King Adolf Frederick and Queen Louisa Ulrika of Sweden.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
